name: RiverWatch
description: RiverWatch is a community science project that turns everyday phone photos of local rivers into a live map of water health across the county.
features: Snap a photo of your local river and get instant water-clarity scoring
Crowd-sourced data feeds a live public health map
Weekly digest emails show trends near you
Partnered with three university hydrology labs for validation
Open API so schools can build their own classroom projects
Volunteer leaderboard to keep local chapters motivated
target_audience: local volunteers, schools, and county environmental offices
call_to_action: Download the app and log your first reading this weekend.
